description: TIRTL Traffic Counts and Classification is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of Transport and Planning. The Infra-Red Traffic Logger (TIRTL) are devices produced by CEOS Pty Ltd which are located across the Victorian road network, and count, classify, and measure the speed of passing vehicles using a non-invasive light based technology. The TIRTL Traffic Counts and Classification dataset aggregates speed and vehicle classification into 15 minute time bins. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Department of Transport and Planning . Its tags are speed, traffic, vehicle class, volume. It offers 6 resource(s) in CSV, ZIP. The portal shows 2026-05-12 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
